newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: OPEC BILATERAL BETWEEN SAUDI, VENEZUELA, IRAN ENDS.
newsitem.headline: OPEC BILATERAL BETWEEN SAUDI, VENEZUELA, IRAN ENDS.

text.p: An OPEC bilateral session between the Iranian, Saudi Arabian and Venezuelan oil ministers, held in the hotel suite of OPEC Secretary General Rilwanu Lukman has ended, Iran's Gholamreza Aghazadeh said.
"I am satisfied with the meeting," he told reporters.
Earlier delegates had said the ministers were meeting to discuss quota compliance.
Also, one Gulf source had said that the meeting was aimed at emphasising quota compliance and not to warn those members producing above their OPEC-assigned quotas.
OPEC is widely expected to freeze its 25.03 million barrels per day (bpd) ceiling for the remainder of the year at its summer conference here this week.
The group's actual output, however, is running around 2.0 million bpd above the ceiling with Venezuela seen contributing around 800,000 bpd to the excess.
